comparison.objective: Vent, load, reseal and evacuate a vacuum desiccator; candidate adjusts and validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Rate-controlled stopcock operation, holding a dome while loading, sealing and switching versus fine hex fastening, collar adjustment and dynamic trials.
comparison.success_condition: Sample loaded, powder undisturbed, vacuum at or below -90 kPa and dome sealed versus two safe repeatable carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Although both require careful sequencing and control actuation, the desiccator tests containment and vacuum handling rather than mechanical damping calibration.
